mapper.select:
SELECT uuid, name, body, status, published_request_uuid, created_at, disabled_date, reason, version FROM request WHERE uuid = #{requestId}
AND status != 'DELETED'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO request (uuid, name, body, status, published_request_uuid, created_at, disabled_date, reason, version) VALUES (#{uuid}, #{name}, #{body}, #{status}, #{publishedRequestUuid}, #{createdAt}, #{disabledDate}, #{reason}, #{version})
mapper.update: UPDATE request SET name = #{name}, body = #{body}, status = #{status}, published_request_uuid = #{publishedRequestUuid}, created_at = #{createdAt}, disabled_date = #{disabledDate}, reason = #{reason}, version = #{version} + 1 WHERE uuid = #{uuid} AND version = #{version}
